verdict.rationale: Metorial documents dedicated provider adapters for the Vercel AI SDK (`@metorial/ai-sdk`, the recommended TypeScript path), OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers. A code sample shows the `adapter: metorialOpenAI.chatCompletions()` pattern, and official SDKs ship for TypeScript, Python and Go. missing for 10: documented LangChain adapter, documented CrewAI adapter, independent or hands-on corroboration that the adapters work as described.
